props.title: The Brown Palace Hotel and Spa
props.lede: The Brown Palace opened in 1892 with a banquet in its ballroom, and it’s still one of the most elegant places in Denver for a wedding, a gala or a holiday party.

headingText.html: Live music is already part of the hotel. There’s piano at afternoon tea in the atrium lobby, and jazz on Friday and Saturday evenings.

props.title: Live music in each Brown Palace event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Grand Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Grand Ballroom is the hotel’s historic ballroom, about 5,800 sq ft, for banquets of up to 400 guests and receptions of up to 480. It divides into two halves of about 2,900 sq ft each.
spaces.why: He can start as a duo and grow to a full band over the evening.
spaces.alt: The Grand Ballroom set classroom-style, with rows of tables facing two projection screens under a chandelier.

spaces.name: Onyx Room
spaces.facts: The Onyx Room is a historic salon of about 1,425 sq ft, for up to 100 guests, with white onyx on the walls and a recreated medallion mural on the ceiling.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.
spaces.alt: The Onyx Room set with round dinner tables, with onyx-clad walls and pillars and a painted ceiling medallion.

spaces.name: Central City
spaces.facts: Central City is about 2,150 sq ft, for banquets of up to 90, and its look goes back to the gold rush.
spaces.why: Flamenco and rumba on Spanish guitar, for a cocktail hour or a dinner.

spaces.name: Brown Palace Club
spaces.facts: The Brown Palace Club is a long space, about 28 by 110 ft, for seated dinners of up to 80. Eisenhower ran his campaign from the hotel, and the club keeps that history.
spaces.why: A solo violin to a full string quartet, from the ceremony through dinner.

spaces.name: Ellyngton’s and the 5280 Suite
spaces.facts: Ellyngton’s is about 5,400 sq ft, for banquets of up to 150 and receptions of up to 250. The 5280 Suite is about 3,500 sq ft, for banquets of up to 220.
spaces.why: Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin and Motown, for a party where people dance.

props.title: Planning music at the Brown Palace

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV on site.
It’s an 1892 building, so we work out load-in and staging with the hotel’s events team ahead of time.
The hotel caters events in-house, and wedding packages include a dance floor and a DJ table.
The atrium has jazz on Friday and Saturday evenings and piano at afternoon tea, so we’ll plan your music to fit around it.
In the holiday season the atrium has carolers and the Champagne Cascade, a tower of over 5,000 champagne glasses.
There’s valet parking at the hotel.

props.html: Questions to ask the Brown Palace events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does the hotel’s AV team need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at the Brown Palace

items.q: Can we bring our own band to a wedding at the Brown Palace?
items.a: Hotels like the Brown Palace generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The Onyx Room to The Grand Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at the Brown Palace?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
